 Due to reduced visibility affecting the medical helicopter's ability to fly, track action at the Australian GP will not commence before 13:00 local time
 Due to reduced visibility affecting the medical helicopter’s ability to fly, Sunday's MotoGP track action at the Red Bull Grand Prix of Australia will be delayed until conditions improve, with track action not commencing before 13:00 local time.
In addition, MotoGP Warm Up has now been cancelled. Another update will be published at 12:30 local time at Phillip Island. 
Keep an eye on MotoGP's social media channels and on motogp.com for the latest.
